styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh summer kids-fashion ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cloud white #FFFFFF, sky blue #EAF4FB, misty grey-blue #BFC9D3, coral-red accent #E4574F and charcoal text #33383D; bright airy soft daylight-style studio lighting with gentle even shadows and soft contact shadows; rounded modern sans-serif typography; minimal hand-drawn doodle accents in one accent color kept at frame edges; clean high-key childrenswear photography mixed with soft illustrated infographic elements; stable flat-lay and slight 3/4 product presentation with true-to-life knit texture; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索首图一眼看清两件套形态，干净合规赢点击

shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, soft contact shadow, no harsh speculars
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A two-piece children summer set laid flat, photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, tank top and shorts neatly arranged and fully visible. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a soft contact shadow grounding the garments. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The set occupies 60-70% of the frame with no extra whitespace reserved for copy. 8K commercial childrenswear quality. Negative: no props, no hangers, no child model, no watermark, no fake logo, no brand patch lettering, no cut-off garment edges, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics.

shots.lighting: bright airy soft daylight from the upper left, gentle soft shadows

shots.lighting: soft skimming light from the upper right revealing knit texture and stitch lines
shots.background: blush-pink knit fabric #F5C9C4 filling the frame
shots.whitespace: minimal, the detail itself is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the neckline binding and overlock stitching. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp. Soft skimming light from the upper right revealing the knit texture and even stitch lines. Blush-pink knit fabric #F5C9C4 fills the frame. The detail fills 55-60% with minimal whitespace. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented thread counts or fabric percentages, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no exaggerated loose threads, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics.

shots.intent: 用留空参数表与空白指数条消除规格疑虑，数值后期合成
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level infographic screen with a close-up seam inset frame along the bottom edge
shots.lighting: even flat high-key light, no dramatic shadow
shots.props: an empty parameter table with blank cells, four blank indicator bars with unfilled marker positions, and three small rounded info cards
shots.whitespace: structured margins on both sides reserved for labels
shots.textZone: left label column and bottom inset caption
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust infographic for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level product view placed at the upper right, with a close-up seam inset frame along the bottom edge. Warm off-white layout board #FAF7F1, even flat high-key light. Layout elements: an empty parameter table with blank cells, four blank indicator bars with unfilled marker positions, and three rounded info cards carrying short labels 「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」. The product and layout occupy 45-55% with structured side margins for labels. Leave every table cell and indicator bar genuinely empty; all figures are composited in post. Negative: do NOT invent size numbers, fabric composition, test reports or certification marks, no filled indicator positions, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：屏1海报式首图，卡通天空草地插画背景配白色背心+浅蓝短裤两件套与珊瑚红大字标题；屏2产品信息表（品牌/名称/货号/颜色/面料/尺码均为空值槽）与四项服装指数滑动条、手工测量备注；屏3-5灰蓝背景平铺展示，粉/白/黄/薄荷绿四色背心换色，道具为相机造型小包与黄色帆布鞋，屏4带素材站水印；屏6领口特写与胸前贴布印花特写；屏7面料纹理特写与短裤缝线花边特写，配面料与工艺说明文案；屏8三栏须知信息卡（色差/尺码/发货）。品类判定：无袖背心+短裤为外穿夏装组合，画面以鞋包配饰整套穿搭呈现，非贴身睡衣家居形态，故判为母婴/童装而非内衣家居服/儿童内衣。已剥离：原品牌腰标字样、素材站水印、原文案原句、面料功效类断言（改为卖点占位符）、指数条与尺码实测数值（改为空白占位）、插画中具体图文；儿童形象一律背影或颈部以下裁切。
